hints.content:
The first term is $-0.1$ and the common ratio is $5$.

| $\footnotesize\maroonC{\times 5\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{\times 5\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{\times 5\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | |
:-: |  :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-:
$-0.1,$ | | $-0.5,$ | | $-2.5,$ | | $-12.5,...$

This is the recursive formula of $-0.1\,,-0.5\,,-2.5\,,-12.5,...$.

$\begin{cases}
c(1)=-0.1
\\\\
c(n)=c(n-1)\cdot 5
\end{cases}$
